constraints.evidence: hold supported ordinary expected cases only; record unsupported exact-parent lanes as out-of-scope rather than substitutes; these fixtures imply neither complete previous corpus retention nor production/default readiness.
constraints.observation: compare selected bytes including all floating NaN payloads without conversion; logical data must be C-order, rank-2 I64 nonzero coordinates need independent strided owner decoding, not physical byte order; expected.raw_le always logical row-major, strides enforce physical mapping.
constraints.owners: each operation output expected fresh owned Tensor, Storage and Version0, disjoint identities versus every co-live input/output; input payload/metadata/version unchanged. Do not require raw IDs to coincide across sessions or all outputs to have monotone physical addresses.
constraints.same_image: all opcodes in each composed route use one combined ELF; exact isolated references use one dedicated pinned image each, never marshal raw tokens across images
constraints.scope: public ordinary CPU roots; row-major input payload and offset 0, no grad. Rank 2 nonzero only on Bool (logic intermediate or optional Bool value input); native typed original nonzero is included only for rank1. No rank2 typed-original request.
